scripts.docs:generate: node scripts/generate-history.mjs && node scripts/generate-impl-flow-index.mjs && node scripts/generate-docs.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run test:docs && pnpm run check:prelaunch-versions && pnpm run check:conformance && pnpm run lint:md && pnpm run lint:terms && pnpm run lint:zh:strict && pnpm run check:refs && pnpm run check:history && pnpm run check:decisions && pnpm run check:frontmatter && pnpm run check:workflows && pnpm run check:docs && pnpm run check:rules && pnpm run check:mermaid
